Business Plan for
Connexite: Selling Networking Switches and SFP Units
on Amazon UK
Executive Summary
Connexite (connexite.co.uk) is a UK-based tech startup specializing in high-quality, managed
industrial and commercial networking switches and SFP units. Our product line includes the 8-
port (CNX-2208-PG), 24-port (CNX-2224-PG), and 48-port (CNX-2248-PG) L2+ PoE+
managed switches, along with 1G LX (CNX-1G-LX) and 10G SR (CNX-10G-SR) SFP units.
Leveraging Amazon’s Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) program, we aim to target small to
medium-sized businesses (SMBs), IT professionals, and enterprises in the UK and Europe. This
plan outlines the FBA process, a robust digital marketing strategy, and a competitive pricing
strategy with launching offers to establish market presence and drive initial sales.
1. Amazon FBA Process for Connexite
Overview of Amazon FBA
Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) allows sellers to store inventory in Amazon’s fulfillment centers,
where Amazon handles picking, packing, shipping, customer service, and returns. This enables
Connexite to offer Prime shipping, enhancing visibility and customer trust.sell.amazon.co.uk
Step-by-Step FBA Process for Connexite
1. Set Up an Amazon Seller Accountyourcompanyformations.co.uk
o Register on Seller Central (sellercentral.amazon.co.uk) as a Professional
Seller (£25/month + VAT) to access advanced tools and ungated categories.
o Provide business details, including Connexite’s UK registration, bank account,
credit card, and tax information.
o Verify identity and business credentials.
2. Product Listing Creationshopify.com
o Product Identifiers: Obtain UPC codes for each SKU (CNX-2208-PG, CNX-
2224-PG, CNX-2248-PG, CNX-1G-LX, CNX-10G-SR) from GS1 UK or request an
exemption if applicable.
o Create Listings: Since these are Connexite-branded private-label products,
select “Add a product not sold on Amazon” in Seller Central. Enter:
▪ Product category (e.g., Electronics > Networking > Switches).
▪ Detailed titles (e.g., “Connexite CNX-2208-PG 8-Port L2+ PoE+
Managed Industrial Switch with 2 1G SFP Uplink Ports”).
▪ High-quality images (minimum 1000x1000 pixels, white background).

[p2]
▪ Bullet points highlighting features (PoE+, L2+ management,
industrial-grade durability, SFP compatibility).
▪ Descriptions emphasizing use cases (SMBs, data centers, enterprise
networks).
▪ Keywords (e.g., “PoE switch,” “managed industrial switch,” “SFP
uplink”).
o Assign SKUs for inventory tracking.
3. FBA Product Restrictions Checkyourcompanyformations.co.uk
o Confirm products meet FBA eligibility (no hazardous materials, proper
packaging).
o Networking equipment is typically unrestricted, but verify category
requirements in Seller Central Help.
4. Prepare Inventory for FBAsell.amazon.co.uk
o Packaging: Ensure products are securely packaged to withstand shipping.
Use sturdy boxes and include manuals, warranties, and branding.
o Labeling: Apply FNSKU barcodes (generated in Seller Central) to each unit.
Alternatively, opt for Amazon’s Barcode Labeling Service for a fee.
o Quality Control: Test samples to ensure functionality and compliance with
UK/EU standards (e.g., CE marking).
5. Ship Inventory to Amazon Fulfillment Centersamzprep.com
o Create a shipping plan in Seller Central, specifying product quantities and
destinations.
o Use Amazon’s Inbound Placement Service to optimize distribution or select
minimal shipment splits to reduce fees (introduced in 2025).amzprep.com
o Ship inventory from Connexite’s UK warehouse to designated Amazon
fulfillment centers using partnered carriers (e.g., UPS, DHL).
o Enroll in the FBA New Selection Program for free shipping to Amazon
warehouses and free storage for eligible new products.sell.amazon.co.uk
6. Manage Inventory and Feessell.amazon.co.uk
o Storage Fees: Charged monthly based on cubic feet (e.g., £0.39–£0.65/cubic
foot, varying by season). Minimize by forecasting demand to avoid long-term
storage fees (£11.25/cubic foot for items stored >181 days).shopify.com
o Fulfillment Fees: Vary by size/weight (e.g., ~£3–£10/unit for networking
equipment, depending on dimensions). Use the Amazon FBA Revenue
Calculator to estimate costs.sell.amazon.co.uk
o Referral Fees: ~8–15% of the sale price for electronics.sell.amazon.co.uk
o Monitor inventory levels via Seller Central to avoid stockouts or
overstocking.
7. Launch and Monitor Saleshealthcarecourses.org.uk
o Once inventory is received (7–14 days), listings go live.
o Use Amazon’s tools (e.g., Seller Central Dashboard) to track sales, reviews,
and performance metrics.
o Enroll in FBA programs like Low-Price FBA for competitive pricing or Pan-
European FBA for EU expansion.sell.amazon.co.uk
8. Customer Service and Returns

[p3]
o Amazon handles customer inquiries, returns, and refunds, reducing
Connexite’s operational burden.
o Monitor feedback and address issues promptly to maintain seller metrics.
Key Considerations
• Incentives: New sellers get 10% back on the first £40,000 in branded sales, then
5% until £800,000 in the first year.sell.amazon.co.uk
• Pan-European FBA: For EU markets, enroll in Pan-European FBA to store
inventory across European fulfillment centers, reducing cross-border shipping
costs.sell.amazon.co.uk
• Compliance: Ensure products meet UKCA (UK Conformity Assessed) and EU CE
standards for electronics.
2. Digital Marketing Plan
Objectives
• Increase brand visibility for Connexite on Amazon and external channels.
• Drive traffic to Amazon listings to boost organic ranking and sales.
• Build trust and credibility for a new tech brand in a competitive market.
Target Audience
• Primary: SMBs, IT managers, and system integrators needing reliable, cost-effective
networking solutions.
• Secondary: Enterprises and data centers requiring scalable, high-performance
switches.
• Demographics: B2B buyers, aged 25–55, tech-savvy, located in the UK and EU.
• Needs: Durable, managed switches with PoE+ and SFP uplinks for network
expansion, remote management, and cost efficiency.
Digital Marketing Strategies
1. Amazon On-Platform Marketing
• Sponsored Adswakecommerce.co.uk
o Sponsored Products: Run keyword-targeted ads for high-intent searches
(e.g., “8-port PoE switch,” “managed industrial switch”). Budget: £100–
£300/day initially, with a target ACoS (Advertising Cost of Sale) of 20–30%.
o Sponsored Brands: Promote Connexite’s brand with custom headlines and
logos, directing to a Brand Store (see below). Budget: £50–£150/day.
o Sponsored Display: Retarget users who viewed listings but didn’t purchase,
both on and off Amazon.

[p4]
o Use automatic and manual campaigns, optimizing for high-converting
keywords via A/B testing.
• Amazon DSP (Demand-Side Platform): For advanced targeting, use DSP to reach
audiences on Amazon’s network and third-party sites. Requires higher budgets
(£5,000+/month) but effective for brand awareness.
• Amazon Brand Store:
o Create a free storefront on Amazon (via Seller Central) showcasing all
Connexite products, brand story, and use cases (e.g., industrial automation,
office networks).
o Include high-quality visuals, comparison charts (8-port vs. 24-port vs. 48-
port), and FAQs.
o Drive traffic via Sponsored Brand ads and external channels.
• Request Reviews:
o Use Amazon’s “Request a Review” feature post-purchase to solicit feedback,
improving listing credibility.
o Avoid incentivized reviews to comply with Amazon’s policies.
2. Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
• Amazon SEOcrunch.co.uk
o Optimize listings with relevant keywords in titles, bullet points, descriptions,
and backend search terms (e.g., “PoE+ switch,” “SFP uplink,” “L2+ managed”).
o Use tools like Helium 10 or Jungle Scout to identify high-volume, low-
competition keywords.
o Monitor keyword performance and update listings monthly.
• External SEO:
o Optimize connexite.co.uk for organic search with blog content (e.g., “How to
Choose a PoE Switch for Your Business,” “Benefits of L2+ Managed
Switches”).
o Target keywords like “industrial PoE switch UK,” “managed switch for SMBs.”
o Build backlinks through guest posts on tech blogs and partnerships with IT
resellers.
3. Content Marketing
• Blog and Guides:
o Publish technical guides on connexite.co.uk (e.g., “Setting Up a PoE+ Network
with Connexite Switches,” “SFP Modules Explained”).
o Share case studies showcasing Connexite products in real-world applications
(e.g., factory automation, office networks).
• Video Content:
o Create YouTube tutorials and unboxing videos for each product, highlighting
features (e.g., PoE+ for IP cameras, SFP for fiber connectivity).
o Embed videos in Amazon listings (Enhanced Brand Content) and share on
social media.

[p5]
• Whitepapers and E-books:
o Offer downloadable resources (e.g., “The Ultimate Guide to Industrial
Networking”) on connexite.co.uk in exchange for email signups, building a
lead database.
4. Social Media Marketing
• Platforms:
o LinkedIn: Target B2B buyers with thought leadership posts, product demos,
and case studies. Join groups like “Network Engineering” and “IT
Infrastructure.”
o Twitter/X: Share industry news, product updates, and engage with tech
influencers. Use hashtags like #Networking, #PoE, #ITInfrastructure.
o YouTube: Host product demos and tutorials, linking to Amazon listings and
connexite.co.uk.
• Paid Ads:
o Run LinkedIn Sponsored Content ads targeting IT managers and SMB owners
(£50–£200/day).
o Use Twitter/X promoted posts for product launches and offers (£20–
£100/day).
• Community Engagement:
o Participate in Reddit communities (e.g., r/networking, r/sysadmin) with
helpful answers, subtly promoting Connexite products.
5. Email Marketing
• Build a List:
o Use website pop-ups and content downloads to collect emails.
o Partner with IT trade shows or webinars to capture B2B leads.
• Campaigns:
o Send welcome emails introducing Connexite’s products and Amazon listings.
o Share monthly newsletters with product tips, industry trends, and
promotional offers.
o Announce launching offers (see Pricing Strategy) to drive urgency.
• Tools: Use Mailchimp or HubSpot for automation and segmentation.
6. Pay-Per-Click (PPC) Advertising
• Google Ads:
o Run Search campaigns targeting keywords like “buy PoE switch UK,”
“managed switch for enterprise” (£100–£300/day).
o Use Display ads for retargeting website visitors.
o Create Shopping ads linking to connexite.co.uk or Amazon listings (if
permitted).
• Microsoft Ads: Target similar keywords for cost-effective reach (£50–£150/day).

[p6]
7. Partnerships and Influencer Marketing
• Tech Influencers:
o Collaborate with YouTube tech reviewers (e.g., channels like Linus Tech Tips
or smaller networking-focused creators) for product reviews.
o Offer free samples in exchange for honest reviews, ensuring compliance with
Amazon’s policies.
• IT Resellers:
o Partner with UK/EU IT distributors to promote Connexite products, offering
bulk discounts.
o Attend trade shows (e.g., IP EXPO Europe) to network with resellers and
showcase products.
8. Public Relations (PR)
• Press Releases:
o Announce product launches via PRWeb or UK tech publications (e.g.,
Computer Weekly, ITPro).
o Highlight Connexite’s UK-based innovation and quality focus.
• Media Outreach:
o Pitch stories to tech journalists about Connexite’s role in supporting SMBs
and industrial automation.
o Secure mentions in “Best Networking Switches of 2025” roundups.
Budget Allocation (Monthly)
• Amazon Ads: £3,000–£5,000
• Google/Microsoft Ads: £1,500–£2,500
• Social Media Ads: £500–£1,000
• Content Creation (videos, blogs): £1,000–£2,000
• Email Marketing Tools: £50–£200
• PR and Influencer Outreach: £500–£1,500
• Total: £6,550–£12,200
Metrics to Track
• Amazon: Sales, conversion rate, ACoS, Buy Box win rate, review count/rating.
• External: Website traffic, click-through rate (CTR), cost per click (CPC), email open
rates, lead generation.
• Brand: Social media engagement, backlink growth, media mentions.

[p7]
3. Pricing Strategy and Launching Offers
Pricing Objectives
• Achieve a 25–30% profit margin after FBA fees, referral fees, and storage
costs.yourcompanyformations.co.uk
• Position Connexite as a value-driven alternative to premium brands (e.g., Cisco,
Netgear) while maintaining quality perception.
• Win the Amazon Buy Box through competitive pricing and Prime
eligibility.optimizon.co.uk
Cost Analysis
Using the Amazon FBA Revenue Calculator and 2025 FBA Rate Card, estimate
costs:amzprep.comsell.amazon.co.uk
• Assumptions (based on typical networking equipment):
o CNX-2208-PG (8-port): Size ~12x8x2 inches, weight ~3 lbs, cost of goods
sold (COGS) ~£50.
o CNX-2224-PG (24-port): Size ~17x10x2 inches, weight ~5 lbs, COGS ~£100.
o CNX-2248-PG (48-port): Size ~19x12x2 inches, weight ~7 lbs, COGS ~£150.
o CNX-1G-LX (SFP): Size ~3x1x0.5 inches, weight ~0.1 lbs, COGS ~£15.
o CNX-10G-SR (SFP): Size ~3x1x0.5 inches, weight ~0.1 lbs, COGS ~£30.
• FBA Fees (approximate, per unit):
o CNX-2208-PG: £5 fulfillment, £0.50 storage/month.
o CNX-2224-PG: £7 fulfillment, £0.80 storage/month.
o CNX-2248-PG: £9 fulfillment, £1.00 storage/month.
o CNX-1G-LX: £2 fulfillment, £0.10 storage/month.
o CNX-10G-SR: £2 fulfillment, £0.10 storage/month.
• Referral Fees: 12% of sale price (electronics category).
• Shipping to Amazon: Free via FBA New Selection Program for initial
inventory.sell.amazon.co.uk
Recommended Retail Prices
• CNX-2208-PG: £99.99
o Total costs: £50 (COGS) + £5 (fulfillment) + £12 (referral) + £0.50 (storage) =
£67.50
o Margin: £99.99 - £67.50 = £32.49 (32.5%).
• CNX-2224-PG: £199.99
o Total costs: £100 + £7 + £24 + £0.80 = £131.80
o Margin: £199.99 - £131.80 = £68.19 (34.1%).
• CNX-2248-PG: £349.99
o Total costs: £150 + £9 + £42 + £1.00 = £202
o Margin: £349.99 - £202 = £147.99 (42.3%).
• CNX-1G-LX: £29.99

[p8]
o Total costs: £15 + £2 + £3.60 + £0.10 = £20.70
o Margin: £29.99 - £20.70 = £9.29 (31%).
• CNX-10G-SR: £59.99
o Total costs: £30 + £2 + £7.20 + £0.10 = £39.30
o Margin: £59.99 - £39.30 = £20.69 (34.5%).
Competitive Analysis
• Compare with brands like TP-Link, Netgear, and Ubiquiti:
o 8-port PoE+ switches: £80–£120.
o 24-port PoE+ switches: £180–£250.
o 48-port PoE+ switches: £300–£450.
o 1G LX SFP: £25–£40.
o 10G SR SFP: £50–£80.
• Connexite’s prices are competitive, offering L2+ management and industrial-grade
features at mid-tier pricing.
Launching Offers
To boost initial sales, rankings, and reviews:healthcarecourses.org.uk
1. Discounted Pricing (First 30 Days):
o CNX-2208-PG: £89.99 (10% off, margin 25%).
o CNX-2224-PG: £179.99 (10% off, margin 27%).
o CNX-2248-PG: £314.99 (10% off, margin 36%).
o CNX-1G-LX: £26.99 (10% off, margin 24%).
o CNX-10G-SR: £53.99 (10% off, margin 28%).
o Promote via Amazon Lightning Deals or Coupons (additional cost ~£100–
£500).
2. Bundle Offers:
o Buy CNX-2208-PG + 2 CNX-1G-LX SFPs for £135 (saves ~£11).
o Buy CNX-2224-PG + 2 CNX-10G-SR SFPs for £285 (saves ~£15).
o List bundles as separate ASINs to increase visibility.
3. Free Shipping on Connexite.co.uk:
o Offer free UK/EU shipping for direct purchases during launch, redirecting to
Amazon for fulfillment.
4. Early Adopter Program:
o Offer a 15% discount code (via email or social media) for the first 100
customers leaving a verified review.
o Ensure compliance with Amazon’s review policies (no incentives tied to
positive reviews).

[p9]
Post-Launch Pricing
• Gradually increase to full prices after 30–60 days, based on sales velocity and
review count.
• Adjust dynamically using Amazon’s Automated Pricing tool to win the Buy Box,
targeting 5–10% below competitors for similar specs.optimizon.co.uk
• During high-demand seasons (e.g., Q4), consider slight price increases (5–10%) if
demand spikes.optimizon.co.uk
Monitoring and Optimization
• Use the Amazon FBA Revenue Calculator to track profitability.sell.amazon.co.uk
• Analyze competitor pricing weekly via tools like Keepa or CamelCamelCamel.
• Maintain stock levels to avoid stockouts, using Amazon’s demand forecasting
tools.optimizon.co.uk
Conclusion
Connexite’s entry into Amazon UK with its L2+ PoE+ managed switches and SFP units is
strategically positioned to capture the growing demand for reliable networking solutions among
SMBs and enterprises. By leveraging Amazon FBA, Connexite can streamline logistics and offer
Prime shipping, enhancing customer appeal. The digital marketing plan, combining Amazon ads,
SEO, content, and B2B outreach, will drive traffic and build brand credibility. The pricing
strategy, with competitive base prices and aggressive launching offers, ensures early traction and
long-term profitability. Regular monitoring of sales, costs, and market trends will enable
Connexite to scale successfully in the UK and EU markets.
Next Steps
1. Register on Seller Central and prepare listings (1–2 weeks).
2. Ship initial inventory to Amazon fulfillment centers (2–3 weeks).
3. Launch Amazon ads and external marketing campaigns concurrently with product
listings going live.
4. Monitor performance weekly, optimizing pricing and ads based on data.
